description: This file handles provider authentication logic, including resolving API keys and OAuth tokens, integrating plugin-based auth, and managing provider credentials within a larger application.

methods.name: resolveProviderApiKeyFromConfigAndStore
methods.description: Resolves the API key or token for a provider from environment variables, config, or stored profiles.

methods.name: resolveOAuthToken
methods.description: Resolves OAuth token for a provider by profile order, returning the token and optional account ID.

methods.name: resolveProviderUsageAuthViaPlugin
methods.description: Uses plugin system to resolve provider authentication details.

methods.name: resolveProviderUsageAuthFallback
methods.description: Fallback method to resolve provider auth via OAuth token or API key.

methods.name: resolveProviderAuths
methods.description: Main exported function to resolve authentication credentials for multiple providers, using plugin and fallback methods.
